briefing: 今日导读：AMD收购李飞飞创办的AI公司，加强其在AI领域的研发能力；Nvidia和Meta发布新平台，提升AI安全和应用规模；OpenAI和Anthropic针对AI模型的安全性和未来发展调整策略，以应对市场竞争和安全挑战。
highlights: 今天AI行业动态活跃，AMD收购李飞飞的World Labs，以及Nvidia和Meta发布新平台显示，AI硬件和应用的竞争愈发激烈。与此同时，OpenAI与Anthropic在面对安全与成本压力时采取不同策略，反映出行业对AI发展与健康治理的分歧与努力。这些事件共同传递了行业加速整合和日益关注安全的信号。

events.title: 李飞飞公司被AMD收购
events.summary: 李飞飞创办的公司被AMD以550亿收购。这一交易被认为是世界模型领域最大规模的交易。此外，李飞飞将担任AMD的首席科学家。
events.insight:
### 一句话本质
AMD以550亿美元收购了由李飞飞创办的公司World Labs，这将加强AMD在AI领域的研究能力。

### 为什么令人兴奋
这笔交易不仅金额巨大，而且标志着传统芯片企业在AI研发上的进一步投入，增强了他们在AI芯片领域的竞争力。

### 产品机会
这为AMD提供了研发强大AI模型的机会，尤其是在计算性能和效率优化上，有望推出创新产品比如新的AI加速芯片。

### 格局影响
对于AMD来说，这是一场重要的产业布局，会影响Intel和Nvidia等竞争对手，同时强化了李飞飞和AMD在AI产业中的领导地位。

### 冷静判断
目前处于收购达成阶段，尚需时间观察其对市场的影响，但这可能会在短期内加强AMD的AI芯片能力。

### 趋势坐标
该事件反映了芯片企业向AI领域扩张的趋势，与最近AI技术加速发展的趋势相吻合。

articles.title: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion
articles.text: World Labs co-founder and CEO Fei-Fei Li. | Bloomberg via Getty Images AMD announced today that it's acquiring World Labs, an AI research lab co-founded by the prominent researcher Dr. Fei-Fei Li, in an all-stock deal worth approximately $8.2 billion. World Labs launched in 2024 and was valued at $1 billion in a matter of months. The startup launched its first commercial product, a world generation model called Marble that lets users make interactive 3D worlds from a prompt, in 2025 . The deal is expected to close by the end of the year. Li will become EVP and chief scientist at AMD, reporting to AMD CEO Lisa Su, while the World Labs team will "continue to focus on advancing AI model research." articles.text: Nvidia is launching a new safety platform designed to contain and monitor AI agents, a move that comes in response to a wave of rogue hacking incidents , as reported earlier by Reuters . In an announcement on Monday , Nvidia says its new Open Agent Safety Platform can quarantine agents that attempt to escape their boundaries within "milliseconds." The platform uses Nvidia's OpenShell open-source software, which runs on the company's Vera AI CPU . Users can choose the information an AI agent can access, and OpenShell checks these restrictions before and during a task, according to Nvidia . It also includes Nvidia's Sentry technology on a separate … Read the full story at The Verge.
